scope: Latest user correction: every paper must show research imagery. This supersedes the earlier text-only fallback policy.

five_thumbnail_visual_re_review.foundation/dust3r: Two RGB views lead to paired colored pointmap layers; scene/geometry artwork dominates.
five_thumbnail_visual_re_review.foundation/mast3r: Two scene views, correspondence marks/lines and descriptor motifs illustrate matching.
five_thumbnail_visual_re_review.foundation/vggt: Multiple scene views lead to point geometry, camera frustums and depth imagery.

publication: Pre-merge local evidence; public correction is verified after the main Pages deployment.
